rationale: Extremely drought-tolerant, resilient to erratic rainfall, rich in calcium and dietary fiber. Highly suitable for semi-arid zones and shallow soils.
key_risks_and_cautions: Vulnerable to blast disease (Magnaporthe grisea) during continuous humid cloudy weather.
Requires proper seed treatment with Trichoderma viride or carbendazim.

rationale: High biomass yield and strong commercial demand for poultry feed, starch industry, and silage. Very responsive to balanced NPK application.
key_risks_and_cautions: High susceptibility to Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda); monitor early whorl stage.
Cannot tolerate waterlogging; ensure ridge-and-furrow planting or good drainage.

rationale: High economic return per unit area. Cool nights (15-20°C) during tuberization promote rapid bulking.
key_risks_and_cautions: Extremely sensitive to Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) when humidity exceeds 85% with cool rains.
Requires certified disease-free seed tubers and prophylactic copper/mancozeb sprays.

soil_types: Clay loam with good organic matter
rationale: Continuous harvesting window provides periodic cash flow. High yield potential with drip irrigation and trellising.
key_risks_and_cautions: Susceptible to Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by whiteflies and early/late blight.
Excessive moisture or rainfall during flowering leads to blossom drop and fruit cracking.

rationale: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen improving soil fertility. Flourishes on residual soil moisture after Kharif harvest.
key_risks_and_cautions: Vulnerable to Fusarium wilt and Pod borer (Helicoverpa armigera).
Avoid heavy irrigation during vegetative stage to prevent excessive foliage at cost of flowering.

rationale: High staple demand and guaranteed minimum support price (MSP) procurement in notified mandis.
key_risks_and_cautions: Requires high assured irrigation (1200-1500 mm). Do not recommend in water-stressed or deficit borewell areas.
Prone to Bacterial Leaf Blight, Blast, and Brown Planthopper (BPH).

soil_types: Loamy soils with good internal drainage
rationale: Deep taproot system accesses subsoil moisture; excellent intercrop with Soybean, Groundnut, or Maize.
key_risks_and_cautions: Water stagnation for more than 48 hours causes devastating Phytophthora stem blight.
Requires pheromone traps for Pod borer monitoring.
